system.description: You grow to a height of 9 feet (3 m) until you use a recovery. Your equipment increases size with you. While enlarged, you add +1 to your Might Edge, you can ignore the first moderate wound you take, and your unarmed attacks inflict 4 damage. While enlarged, your dodge tasks are hindered. Each time you use Enlarge, the Might cost increases by 1. The cost resets after you take a recovery. Last action; enabler to use again to remain enlarged. If you have multiple abilities that let you grow to a larger size, their effects don't add together—you just get the benefits from the biggest one.
